rationale: Makes Perfetto tracing reachable from the CLI instead of requiring a hand-edited CMake cache: pulp build gains --trace, which configures -DPULP_TRACING=ON into a separate build-trace/ tree because PULP_TRACING reaches every translation unit, plus --allow-tracing as the explicit acknowledgement required before a tracing build is installed into a user's plug-in folders. pulp sdk install gains a trace profile alongside forge-dev, published only when the built archives are verified to actually carry Perfetto. The family is crossed by exactly one path: docs/status/cli-commands.yaml, the repo-wide CLI command manifest, which is a design-output-and-packaging selector. That edit documents the two new build flags and the new SDK profile and nothing else. No importer, design-import, packaging, template, release-workflow or installed-SDK-staging code changes -- the other twenty changed paths in this branch match no selector in this family. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a documentation change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: pulp-test-cli-local-sdk-profile (trace profile policy, archive tracing-capability verification, and provenance coverage)
python3 tools/ci/test_install_linux_build_deps.py (tracing-build.yml declared as a two-job adopter of the canonical Linux dependency action)
python3 tools/scripts/test_sdk_provenance.py (tracing capability recorded in SDK provenance)
